test_title: PYST 69: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

If I **was you**, I would resign immediately.
solution:
The correct answer is '**were you**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subjunctive mood is used to express hypothetical or unreal situations. In this case, the sentence begins with "If I," indicating a hypothetical scenario.
 
• The correct form is "were" (not "was") when using the subjunctive mood in conditional sentences like this one.
 
• **Options 1, 3, 4,** and **5** are incorrect as they are either grammatically incorrect or do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"If I **were you**__, I would resign immediately."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "was in your place"** is incorrect because "was" does not follow the subjunctive rule in hypothetical scenarios.
 
• **Option 3: "would be you"** is incorrect because it does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "am you"** is incorrect because it is grammatically incorrect in this context.
